ja510:1.1: Yam ekarattiṃ paṭhamaṃ gabbhe vasati mānavo abbh' uṭṭhito va sayati sa gacchaṃ na nivattati.
ja510:2.1: Na yujjhamānā na balena vassitā narā na jīranti na cīpi mīyare, sabbaṃ hi taṃ jātijarāy' upaddutaṃ, tam me matī hoti: carāmi dhammaṃ.
ja510:3.1: Caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ subhiṃsarūpaṃ jayanti raṭṭhādhipatī pasayha, na maccuno jayituṃ ussahanti, tam me etc. Hatthīhi
ja510:4.1: assehi rathehi pattihi parivāritā muccare ekaceyyā, na maccuno muccituṃ ussahanti, etc. Hatthīhi
ja510:5.1: assehi rathehi pattihi sūrā pabhañjanti padhaṃsayanti, na maccuno bhuñjituṃ ussahanti, etc. Mattā gajā
ja510:6.1: bhinnagaḷā pabhinnā nagarāni maddanti janaṃ hananti, na maccuno maddituṃ ussahanti, etc. Issāsino
ja510:7.1: katahatthāpi dhīrā dūrepātī akkhaṇavedhino pi na maccuno vijjhituṃ ussahanti, etc. Sarāni khīyanti
ja510:8.1: saselakānanā, sabbaṃ hi taṃ khīyati dīgham antaraṃ, sabbaṃ hi taṃ bhañjare kālapariyāyaṃ, etc. Sabbesam evaṃ
ja510:9.1: hi narānarīnaṃ calācalaṃ pāṇabhuno 'dha jīvitaṃ paṭo va dhuttassa dumo va kūlajo, etc. Dumapphalāneva
ja510:10.1: patanti mānavā daharā ca vuddhā ca sarīrabhedā nariyo narā majjhimaporisā ca, etc. Nāyaṃ vayo tārakarājasannibho,
ja510:11.1: yad abbhatītaṃ gatam eva dāni taṃ, jiṇṇassa hī n' atthi ratī kuto sukhaṃ, etc. Yakkhā pisācā
ja510:12.1: athavāpi petā kupitāpi te assasantī manusse, na maccuno assasit' ussahanti, etc. Yakkhe pisāce
ja510:13.1: athavāpi pete kupite pi te nijjhapanaṃ karonti, na maccuno nijjhapanaṃ karonti, etc. Aparādhake dūsake
ja510:14.1: heṭhake ca rājāno daṇḍenti viditva dosaṃ, na maccuno daṇḍayit' ussahanti, etc. Aparādhakā dūsakā
ja510:15.1: heṭhakā ca labhanti te rājino nijjhapetuṃ, na maccuno nijjhapanaṃ karonti, etc. Na khattiyo ti
ja510:16.1: na pi brāhmaṇo ti, na aḍḍhakā balavā tejavāpi, -- na maccurājassa apekha-m-atthi, etc. Sīhā ca vyagghā
ja510:17.1: ca atho pi dīpiyo pasayha khādanti vipphandamānaṃ, na maccuno khāditum ussahanti, etc. Māyākārā raṅgamajjhe
ja510:18.1: karontā mohenti cakkhūni janassa tāvade, na maccuno mohayit' ussahanti, etc. Āsīvisā kupitā
ja510:19.1: uggatejā ḍasanti mārenti pi te manusse, na maccuno ḍasituṃ ussahanti, etc. Āsīvisā kupitā
ja510:20.1: yaṃ ḍasanti tikicchakā tesaṃ visaṃ hananti, na maccuno daṭṭhavisaṃ hananti, etc. Dhammantarī
ja510:21.1: Vetaraṇī ca Bhojo visāni hantvāna bhujaṅgamānaṃ sūyanti te kālakatā tath' eva, etc. Vijjādharā ghoram
ja510:22.1: adhīyamānā adassanaṃ osadhehi vajanti, na maccurājassa vajant' adassanaṃ, etc. Dhammo have
ja510:23.1: rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham āvahāti, esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe: na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.
ja510:24.1: Na hi dhammo adhammo ca ubho samavipākino, (Dhp. 90,3.) adhammo nirayaṃ neti, dhammo pāpeti suggatin ti.
